reviews.title: Great if You Love Living in 2005. Latency Galore & Limited Features
reviews.text:
Unlike Tesla, this app requires internet, so that gmc can maximize shareholder value.

 Lose service and this app is useless. 

I can turn climate on. It. No options to set defrost to full or anything else.  

No pet/dog mode. 

Want to change your charge threshold or anything else? The latency is so bad you might as well walk to the car and just do it from there 

Can’t use the watch app unless your phone is connected 

No phone as key functionality. 

No CarPlay / android auto.   That would be fine if the vehicle software was actually good.  I love love love my truck but the overall integration into daily life is trash because it’s clear to me GMC is more about squeezing every last dollar out of the consumer rather than delivering professional grade software.

reviews.title: 8.20.0 update
reviews.text: I hate the new update! No auto start, locking/unlocking or gas gauge read on the app. This was my main reason for having the app. I appreciate being able to still see my tire pressure and oil life however the rest has made having the app redundant and pointless.

reviews.title: Latest Update Sucks
reviews.text:
Latest update breaks some of the basic functions like the fact that it shows the truck is always unlocked regardless of actual state. As a result, you cannot use the app to unlock your truck anymore. myGMC quality control is terrible. They come out with new releases that seem to break basic and older functionality.

I suspect if they choose to respond to this, they will tell me to go to a website and submit a support ticket. No! Just fix your app.

reviews.title: Bad app interface
reviews.text:
Not one to review things but this app deserves one. The pros are I feel the data it shares is productive and helpful. It’s accurate and responsive. And does work fairly well.

The cons are that the watch app is constantly accidentally starting from truck, unlocking it and even beeping the horn through the slightest touch. I wish it had a slide to start feature or hold to activate rather than a simple tap. Its very frustrating when I am washing my hands or even completing simple daily tasks and I get a notification that my truck is started or its doing the trailer light sequence etc.  Otherwise the lack of a “scheduled starts” is frustrating coming from the ford app where it was easily set up and always worked. My ford would start itself every morning without me lifting a finger. I wish better for the app as they make really great vehicles just need the app to match that caliber.

reviews.title: Not working again
reviews.text: Once again my app does not show any current stats . Even after the update . My fuel level , mileage and other readings still show from 2 fuel tanks ago . And the app shows my truck continuously at the same location even when I’m not there ! Geo location never works !  Nothing resets it . And the dealers answer - “ we have nothing to do with the app “ and “ yeah - everybody hates it “ . I think that speaks volumes ! We’re all beta testers !

reviews.title: MyGMC App
reviews.text: There’s a significant delay in commands between the MyGMC app and the vehicle. I’ve had it once where I turned on the alarm through the app and the ship alarm button grayed out not allowing me to turn it off. I tried hard closing the app to reopen it to the same issue. Then had to sign out of the app to sign back in and that fixed the problem. I was then able to turn off the alarm to my vehicle- which again took more time than I would like for confirmation the vehicle received my command through the app. In my gmc sierra I don’t have the ability to change the climate through the app. I’d like to see that update in the future. To include the ability to turn and off heated/ cool seats and heated steering wheel. For a 2026 model vehicle these features should be a given. I had these features and more on a 2022 model y Tesla- to include the ability to crack or close my windows via the app.

reviews.title: Poor quality and service
reviews.text:
You would think if purchasing $100,000 pick up truck that the functionality of the mobile app would work at least 50% of the time. However, unlike every other vehicle in the last 10 years, this app has worked less than five times in the entire years that I’ve owned this vehicle. To the point that it truly can’t even. do basic functions such as lock or unlock and definitely has not one time ever started the vehicle. 
My other vehicle is a 23 GMC Yukon and it does work about 50% of the time, but it will only start the vehicle if we are standing right next to it which again is useless if that’s the only place that it works

reviews.title: Developers make it worse with every update
reviews.text: This was such a great looking and working app just 6 months ago. Large beautiful round button right in the center for remote start. Could see vehicle settings and sort radio presets/favorites and other settings. Now it’s ugly little icons and the ability to manage vehicle settings is completely gone. Random number under vehicle name is assumed to be gas mileage remaining but no explanation is provided. Just a guess. Viewing the app instructions in the help center doesn’t update and just teases the old beautiful app and all the functionality we have lost. I would fire the whole app development team and the marketing team that most likely directs these changes. Terrible app now. Was great 6 months ago.
